questions.q: Anchorline Systems' original request was "something that feels instant, doesn't blow up our cloud bill, and we can run ourselves." Why isn't that usable as-is?
options: It isn't translated into concrete latency, throughput, cost, and context requirements yet
It doesn't name a specific cloud provider
It doesn't specify a programming language
It is already a complete specification
questions.explain: A request like this has to be turned into concrete targets — p99 TTFT, concurrent user count, GPU budget, and context length — before it can drive a model or deployment decision.

questions.q: Which factor made Mixtral 8x7B Instruct a poor fit for this specific capstone's budget, despite its higher quality ceiling?
options: It is not an open-weight model
It has no instruction-tuned variant
Its ~47B total parameters don't comfortably fit the single mid-range GPU budget without aggressive quantization
It only supports a 2K context window
questions.explain: Mixtral 8x7B's mixture-of-experts design means a higher total parameter count than the memory budget for a single 24GB-class GPU comfortably allows at full precision.

questions.q: Which model was selected for the Anchorline Systems capstone, and why?
options: Mixtral 8x7B Instruct, for its mixture-of-experts quality ceiling
Llama 3.1 8B Instruct, because it clears the quality bar, fits the license, and fits a single 24GB-class GPU
Mistral 7B Instruct v0.3, because it is the smallest model available
Llama 3.1 70B Instruct, for maximum quality
questions.explain: Llama 3.1 8B Instruct was chosen because it meets the quality bar, its license fits internal use, its 128K context covers the use case, and it fits the single-GPU deployment budget.

questions.q: In this capstone's context, what does 'TTFT' measure?
options: Total tokens for training
Time-to-first-token — how long a user waits before a response starts streaming
The time it takes to fine-tune the model
Total throughput for training
questions.explain: TTFT, time-to-first-token, is the latency metric that matters most for a chat-style interface: how long before the first piece of the answer appears.

Kafka & Event Streaming and Terraform & Bicep
Tableau and Snowflake
